title: Network Relationship, Service Class and Cost Share on Corrected TRICARE Select Outpatient Lines
content:
**Clause.** Where the provider was not in the network on the service date, the cost share on a corrected **TRICARE Select** outpatient line is the tier's non-network outpatient percentage of the amount left once the deductible is taken off, rounded to the cent; where the provider was in the network and the line is durable medical equipment, it is the tier's network durable medical equipment percentage of the amount left, rounded to the cent; where the provider was in the network and the line is preventive care or the tier's network basis is fixed copayment, it is the tier's network copayment for the line's service class, never more than the amount left; otherwise it is the tier's network outpatient percentage of the amount left, rounded to the cent.

The provider's network relationship and the service class are those recorded on the reversed line; the amount left is the amount cost-shared less the deductible taken.

## Tier figures

| Tier | Network basis | Network outpatient percentage | Non-network outpatient percentage | Network durable medical equipment percentage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4) | percent of allowed | 15 | 20 | 15 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-5 and Above) | percent of allowed | 15 | 20 | 15 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-1 to E-4) | fixed copayment | 0 | 20 | 10 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-5 and Above) | fixed copayment | 0 | 20 | 10 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A | percent of allowed | 20 | 25 | 20 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group B | fixed copayment | 0 | 25 | 20 |

The network copayment is the tier's copayment for the line's service class in the TRICARE Select network copayment schedule.

## Cases in order

| Provider on the service date | Line | Cost share on the amount left |
|---|---|---|
| not in the network | any | non-network percentage |
| in the network | durable medical equipment | network durable medical equipment percentage |
| in the network | preventive care, or any class on a fixed-copayment tier | the network copayment, capped at the amount left |
| in the network | any other class on a percent-of-allowed tier | network outpatient percentage |

## Hypothetical lines (amount left 120.00)

- TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, non-network: 25 percent, 30.00.
- TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, network durable medical equipment: 20 percent, 24.00.
- TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, network specialty care visit: copayment 56.00 (less than 120.00).
- TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, network primary care visit: 20 percent, 24.00.
